sections.heading: Planning your Dunearn House interior
sections.text:
Dunearn Road is a long, established residential and institutional corridor rather than a brand-new waterfront. Owners here often already know the neighbourhood and want the new apartment to feel settled: a proper place for shoes and bags, a living room with a built-in storage wall, bedrooms with full-height wardrobes, and a kitchen that can take family cooking. A common bedroom is frequently asked to work as a study; a built-in desk and wardrobe along one wall is the usual, quieter answer. Maison specifies this as custom carpentry, not as loose, flat-pack furniture, and we will draw it from your approved plan, not from a generic District 11 layout.

No official floor plan is on file, so typologies and room sizes are not listed. Watten House on Shelford Road and The Serra Residences, also in District 11, are nearby pages on this site; they are not a substitute for your drawings. We will not invent a walking time to Novena, to Bukit Timah, or to any campus or hospital along the corridor. Check facing, traffic noise and the management rules on window and balcony treatments before you plan a bench, a desk under a window, or blinds.

When you have a key date in writing, leave time for defects inspection, measurement and renovation approval before carpentry is fabricated. A moderate, non-structural carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals — an editorial figure, not a promise. WhatsApp Maison with your plan and unit type. We are an independent designer and are not affiliated with the developer.
